_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this repo's sim/ evidence is generated against. Shape follows 2AMLogic/sg13g2-bandgap sim/pdk.json (pinned in reuse.lock.json). sim/check-pins.sh checks this file against the installed tree. Not otherwise consumed by tooling.
tarball_sha256_source: copied from 2AMLogic/sg13g2-bandgap sim/pdk.json at b16eb968473856b26185b05fbb49146731b8ad13; not re-derived here
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

installed_tree_as_checked.note: the installed tree is the fleet PDK store's bundle of v0.3.0 (a repacked artifact), so its bundle hash differs from the upstream release tarball hash above

ngspice.local_dispatch_worker: 42 -- cannot load the v0.4 OSDI binaries; local runs fail with osdi_abi_mismatch

osdi_toolchain.approach: source-compile the PDK's own Verilog-A models with a checksum-pinned prebuilt OpenVAF-Reloaded compiler
osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo; no .osdi is committed)
osdi_toolchain.pins_authority: the script itself; compiler asset and libLLVM hashes are in sim/harness/common/build-osdi.sh
osdi_toolchain.built_by_this_repo_note: the .osdi files in the installed tree were provisioned with the PDK store bundle; pdk-smoke records their sha256 per run. Rebuild with the script on a host of your own.
